Initial release of persona-project-manager

- Coordinate projects by tracking tasks, scheduling meetings, and sharing documents.
- Integrates with GWS Drive, Sheets, Calendar, Gmail, and Chat (requires utility skills to be loaded).
- Includes workflows for standup reports, weekly digests, and file announcements.
- Provides step-by-step instructions and tips for project management operations.
- Sample commands and best practices outlined for efficient team coordination.
